title: Regula-Raising Cane's
body: Raising Cane's plans to open in Berkeley! To estimate profits, the owner builds a linear model.\nIn part (a), the owner collects $$n=30$$ observations and fits an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) model with $$29$$ features (e.g., foot traffic, temperature, etc.) with an intercept (30 parameters total). The model is\n$$\hat{y}_i=\hat{\theta}_0+\hat{\theta}_1x_{i1}+\hat{\theta}_2x_{i2}+...+\hat{\theta}_{29}x_{i29}$$
